blind.description: A stylized fantasy piece consisting of a low, circular carved stone basin or collar decorated with geometric relief patterns, from which three thick purple tentacles with pink suction cups emerge and curl upward. The surfaces are smooth, stylized, and continuous with no holes, floating flakes, or mesh defects. It rests stably on its flat circular stone rim.
blind.from_above: A circular carved stone ring framing three purple curling tentacle tops aligned across the center, with suckers visible on their underside curves.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third the height of the figure (roughly 2 feet tall) and about 1.5 to 2 feet wide.
